toegepas.voor: beteken daar is baie waterdamp in die lug
toegepas.na: beteken dat daar baie waterdamp in die lug is
toegepas.rede_vinder: Written Afrikaans prefers the full dat-clause with the verb at the end after 'beteken'.
toegepas.fout: Loose spoken construction after 'beteken' without 'dat' and with main-clause word order.
toegepas.rede_keurder: The full dat-clause is the natural written form and the meaning is unchanged.
